text:
Ravi Shah: PR up to add Tilde-8B "model card quickstart" and a small limits table. https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/872
Mira Patel: thanks Ravi. Can you double-check variant IDs? our registry uses dashes.
Ravi Shah: fixed to tilde-8b-aurora-quant and tilde-8b-fp16.
Jonah Reed: can we include a short bench note: current numbers were measured on A100s with runtime v1.13? otherwise folks will assume our newer kernel perf.
Ravi Shah: added parenthetical and TODO to re-run on v1.14. Created ticket INF-1910 and linked in PR.
Zoe: small request: the quickstart python snippet used `max_seq` (old param). Updated to `max_length` and tested streaming locally.
Ravi Shah: pushed that change.
Samira (docs-bot): linkcheck: one broken anchor (#tilde8b-bench). Recommendation: use /internals/benchmarks#tilde-8b.
Ravi Shah: updated link and table formatting.
Mira Patel: nit: add compat note about aurora-quant falling back to aurora-fp16 when kernels unavailable and perf caveat >16k.
Ravi Shah: added compat note and short recommendation.
Jonah Reed: LGTM. Mira?
Mira Patel: approved.
Samira (docs-bot): PR merged by Ravi Shah at 4512200278. Changelog updated: "tilde-8b: quickstart, limits table, SDK snippet fix, compatibility note"
Zoe: thanks all.
